content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible or heavily restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in monetizing their work. This guide addresses how to build a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-works-how-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-11|USDT Payment]]s-tanzanian-online-sellers-what-actually-how-3|crypto]] store on Cloudflare Pages, enabling you to bypass conventional payment systems. By leveraging the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can launch a fully operational online store that processes crypto payments seamlessly and securely, ensuring you maintain complete ownership of your data and products.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure designed by COREMERCH is built for resilience. Traditional platforms often restrict access based on geographic location or regulatory concerns, leaving creators isolated. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages combined with NOWPayments, you create a self-sufficient digital storefront. This architecture enables you to operate independently of external payment processors, ensuring that you can reach a global audience without the limitations imposed by conventional financial systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, gather essential components: a Cloudflare account, a GitHub account, and a NOWPayments account. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, whether they are ebooks, courses, or software. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides comprehensive documentation for deploying your stack effectively. This preparation is crucial for a smooth setup and deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment setup through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Next, set up your Cloudflare Pages to host your store, utilizing GitHub for version control and collaboration. Implement Google Apps Script to handle backend logic, ensuring that orders are processed efficiently. Finally, link your storage solution, such as Google Drive, to deliver your digital products automatically upon payment confirmation. This streamlined pipeline ensures a seamless customer experience.
Establish infrastructure sovereignty with a self-hosted crypto store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is configured and your products are uploaded, it’s time to go live. Publish your site on Cloudflare Pages and test your payment integration using a small transaction. Ensure that all components interact correctly and that product delivery occurs as intended. Monitor the process for any issues and resolve them promptly to provide a reliable purchasing experience for your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your store and processing initial transactions, consider scaling your operations. Analyze customer behavior and sales data to identify opportunities for new products or marketing strategies. Utilize the insights from the Sovereign Blueprint to add more products to your stack, optimize pricing strategies, and improve customer engagement. This ongoing process of evaluation and adaptation will help you maximize your store's potential.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
No subscriptions or dependencies on external platforms—own your business.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a free digital store accepting crypto payments, utilize Cloudflare Pages to host your site, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing transactions. This combination allows you to operate independently of traditional financial systems.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, offering an end-to-end tested solution deployed in 48 hours. Stack 02 provides more features for scalability.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each offers unique advantages, with GitHub Pages being simpler for static sites and Cloudflare Pages providing advanced features for dynamic content.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins. This extensive support enables you to cater to a wide range of customers and their preferred payment methods.
How does the payment process work with NOWPayments?

The payment process with NOWPayments involves integrating their API into your store. Once a customer makes a transaction, NOWPayments verifies it on-chain and automatically triggers delivery of the product without requiring a buyer account or KYC.
